item.description:
Mergekeeper 0.1.1

  • fix(release): avoid pipefail false negative in hardened-runtime check
  • docs(release): host updates on the public releases repo; add publish-updates script
  • feat(release): Developer ID release pipeline, Sparkle updates, blank team defaults
  • feat(ui): single status bar across the main window with collapsing chips; main CI; snapshots
  • feat(notifications): permission flow, categories, quiet hours, ledger dedupe, actions, launch at login, menu-bar residency
  • docs: agents screen, transcripts, counts
  • fix(core): read each Keychain secret once and cache it; stable local signing identity script
  • fix(ui): Agents list filters fit narrow panes; plain stack for normal-length transcripts
  • fix(ui): bound the narrow-window PR detail sheet and keep its content at a readable width
  • fix(ui): one GroupCounts source for every PR count; loading rows no longer counted as Needs you
  • feat(ui): Agents screen, conversation view, inspector transcript, retention settings, snapshots
  • feat(core): agent transcript model, parsers, persistence, follow-up planning
  • feat: personal access token is the default GitHub link; Data & Security pane
  • feat(core): data and security hardening, Codex keyring login, tests
  • fix(core): derive approval state from GitHub reviewDecision, handle code owners
  • fix(ui): dock the PR inspector inside the window layout, wrap its text; specific agent failure reasons
  • feat(core): URLSession GitHub runner behind CommandRunning; Core builds for iOS
  • test: startAgent eligibility requires an enabled, non-cooling account
  • feat: agent accounts UI, usage strip, docs, OAuth client id placeholder
  • feat(core): agent account balancer with strategies, cooldown failover and caps
  • feat: generated app icon (Scripts/make-icon.swift, AppIcon.icns)
  • Responsive UI, Releases/Open PRs/Accounts views, multi-pane settings, snapshot harness
  • feat(core): OAuth device flow, isolated agent CLI logins, open-PR and release reads
  • feat(core): release tracking, per-repo settings and rich-text review requests
  • test: smoke test uses the app's Keychain token
  • docs: describe Keychain credentials and opt-in agents
  • feat(app): paste-a-token GitHub sign-in and opt-in agent accounts UI
  • feat(core): keychain-only GitHub token, scrubbed gh/git env, opt-in agents
  • fix(core): strip OPENAI_API_KEY from agent environment
  • docs: add README with agent safety model, design notes, license and contributing guide
  • feat(app): add SwiftUI dashboard, detail inspector, menu bar extra and settings
  • test(core): cover classifier, check filtering, Slack, merged pruning and agent safety
  • feat(core): add PR monitoring core with gh client, classifier and agent runner
